title: Add Bees Pollination to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Bees Pollination](https://halimyassine.github.io/bees-pollination-app) to image
- Bees Pollination is a simple AI image generation app powered by Pollinations. Users connect their Pollinations account, enter a text prompt, and generate an image directly in the browser using the Pol

Fixes #15237

gist.headline: A garden for generated pixels
gist.blurb: Bees Pollination has joined the image garden: connect an account, describe a scene, and let the browser grow it into pixels. One more small app where an idea can turn into an image before the tea gets cold.
gist.summary: Added Bees Pollination to the image app directory, a browser-based Pollinations image generator where users connect their account, enter a text prompt, and generate images directly in the app.
gist.impact: People can now discover and use Bees Pollination from the image collection for a simple account-connected, prompt-to-image workflow in the browser.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Bees Pollination as a cozy browser-based image garden: Polli tends flowering prompt cards that bloom into tiny framed generated landscapes beside a retro web terminal. Polli is the guide connecting a user's idea to the garden, with a tiny gardener hat; use code-plants and a visible browser window to represent the app directory addition.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art scene of the cute Polli bee mascot, with a yellow body, dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blushes, a small happy smile, and small rounded light-blue translucent wings, wearing a tiny gardener hat and tending a browser window where prompt cards bloom into framed AI images; code-plants, flowers, and a retro terminal grow around it, with pixel-font text “BEES POLLINATION.” Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful.
